notes.title: SEQUENCE STORM HALLOWEEN EVENT
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33822168/95f8620ba5c9c667b86e22f99c4e65ae0d6cdc68.png[/img]

[h1]HALLOWEEN EVENT[/h1]

Participate in the Halloween Event to unlock exclusive rewards that will only be available around this time of year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33822168/e4e3fb3f75a80b5de428d2ab7a782f9b37dcccb8.png[/img]

[h1]IMPROVED WORKSHOP INTEGRATION[/h1]

The SEQUENCE STORM Arcade will now automatically load up information about tracks in the Steam Workshop.  You can now download tracks directly in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33822168/f6e219e1d89408b81437edef1c6582b841fdd0d7.png[/img]

Open the workshop options with F2 or the gamepad back button.  From here you can upvote and downvote tracks, or select which workshop tracks you want to be shown in the Arcade (highest rated, newest, or none).

notes.title: SEQUENCE STORM Gets Practice Mode!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33822168/9b3aec3ddcc0650c9668f533e6505bafda0734ae.jpg[/img]

Update 1.4.2 adds a practice mode that is available in the pause menu in the Arcade!

Turn on practice mode to enable these features:

- Scroll up and down the track.
- Set a custom restart point to practice specific parts of a track.
- Turn on autoplay.
- Adjust the game speed inside the pause menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33822168/3e974d93263ba7878ba66677f470ab0c7659051c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.4.1s
notes.content:
- Custom tracks have a much smaller track.json file
- In the world editor, the set piece list on the right can be scrolled with the mouse wheel
- Fixed a bug where the target bar would disappear before the track ended.
- Fixed a bug where the player's combo would disappear before the track ended.

notes.title: Update 1.4.0d
notes.content: Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the first mission to be impossible to complete.

notes.title: 1.3.4k
notes.content: Fixed issues with ad banners.

notes.title: 1.3.4j
notes.content: Fixed another method of accessing unowned campaigns.

notes.title: Update 1.3.4i
notes.content:
- Fixed display issues with the on-screen button prompts in tutorials.
- Prevent switching to a campaign the user doesn't own by using the reset mission progress menu.
- Fixed a bug in the first mission where the rivals could speed ahead.
- Fixed being able to skip the intro in missions.
- Editor: Reverse zig zag direction is now ctrl+shift+r instead of ctrl+alt+r.
- Fixed a bug where the quit-without-saving prompt could be active but invisible.

notes.title: Update 1.3.4h
notes.content:
- The "reduced flashing" option prevents objects in the world from changing color.
- World editor: Fixed a possible crash on changing skyboxes.
- Song editor: The "X Position Follows Track Center" setting can now be toggled at any point on the track.
- Parameter editing: "Interpolate Parameter Values" now uses I as a shortcut key.

Olokun Dive! Beta Test:
- Added the soundtrack files to soundtrack\OlokunDive
- More progress on new tracks.

notes.title: Update 1.3.4g
notes.content:
1.3.4g
- Fixed a bug where the draw distance was not working properly with the near/medium/far settings.
- Fixed a bug where jump notes were appearing in the editor incorrectly when editing a track with a looping spline.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3k
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug causing some models that should be on the side of the track to appear in the wrong place.
- Each Trial Sequence is now unlocked by completing the previous trial.  Only trials 1 through 4 are available by default.
- There is a new menu for selecting leaderboard badges on the customization screen.
- Fixed a content build issue on my end where some DLCs were not getting properly updated.

Leaderboards:
- Changed how options that make the game easier are handled on the leaderboards.  Options that reduce the number of notes or holds in a track will no longer apply any leaderboard score reduction.  Instead, the player will simply miss out on the points for the notes or holds that have been removed.
- In audible cues 1 mode, fixed an issue where score reduction for options was being applied before scaling the score up to meet the normal number of notes in the track.

Editor:
- You can now toggle the active zig zags with alt-z.  Options that move/edit zig zags will only apply to the active zig zags.
- Mirroring zig zag notes with ctrl-r now correctly positions them.
- Mirror notes (ctrl-r) now only reverses notes associated with the selected channel.
- You can now adjust the size of a zig zag hold with alt left/right when the hold is under the cursor.
- When setting hold duration with shift+note button, if the cursor is on a note without a hold, it will set the hold duration for the previous note.
- The track stretch parameter is now only shown when using the player camera (ctrl-space).
- Disabled changing autoplay accuracy with F2.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3h - Crash fix
notes.content: Fixed a crash that some players were getting in menus.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3g
notes.content:
- Added Steam leaderboard badges for completing the "Pretty Little Mind" mission of Jelly's Racway.
- Hold notes are more opaque (especially jump note holds)
- Made the hold end marker a bit less annoying.
- The hold end marker now draws on all holds.
- Added the zig zag hold particles back.
- Fixed an issue where jump notes were drawing in a too pale color.
- Camera barrel roll modified slightly to wobble a bit less after the roll.
- Fixed options menu text being too big and going off the screen.

Editor Changes
- Select a range with the mouse uses shift-click instead of ctrl-click.
- Page up and down behavior changes depending on the bpm.
- Player camera mode (Ctrl-Space) will be disabled if you try to pan or zoom the camera.
- Track spline editor changes:
	Q turns on slide mode
	A disables slide mode
	Constrain along up vector (u) becomes constrain along normal (n)
	Constrain toward track shortcut is now T (was Shift-T)
	Aim normal at track is now Ctrl-T (was T)
	Added aim normal away from track command: Ctrl-Shift-T
	Select the next/previous points is now J and K (was up/down)
- Spline editor: Added a "Set Track Starting Offset" that allows the track to start before the first beat of the track, however this is still being developed.
- Editor: Stretch isn't applied to the view in the track spline editor or the environment editor.
- Added a bunch of new set pieces for Olokun Dive! which are still in development.
- Parameters editor: Added icons to show the interpolation type of each edit.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3f
notes.content:
- Added a reset purchases option to the settings menu.  This removes all items and stat points, and gives the player credits for every completed mission.
- saves/progress.json backup files will only be created once per session, rather than every time the game saves.
- Some note colors are more saturated.
- Hold notes are more opaque.
- Hold notes flash slightly while being held.
- There is a marker at the end of column hold notes to show that the player should let go at the end.
- Added a note flash effect when completing a column note hold successfully.
- Removed the flashing particle at the beginning of zig zag hold notes.
- Song editor: added a shortcut key for setting zig zag size: Shift-Z.
- Added friction sparks to rigs that shoot out either forwards or backwards when being slowed or when accelerating.
- Some rig effects like friction sparks now also happen in score mode.
- Fixed some visible gaps between track models.
- Added a water color override option to the edit world menu in the world editor.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3e
notes.content:
- Keyboard steering sensitivity has been removed and replaced with a general steering sensitivity that applies to all control methods.  The new default value is 3/5, down from 5/5.
- There is a new animation for jump notes.
- Rhythm control labels are now only shown in beginner difficulty and tutorials.
- All rhythm UI and note hit effects are colored according to the user's preferences.
- Rig acceleration and deceleration move the camera forwards and backwards a bit.
- Many UI elements and rhythm gameplay graphics no longer draw with bloom or chromatic aberration.
- Song editor: The column selection for the notes editor and the parameters editor is now separate.
- Fixed a bug where yellow arrows in the loadout could draw sideways.
- Fixed using ctrl-space to toggle the game camera in the parameter editor.
- Rigs can no longer take damage when editing or after the track has been completed.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3a
notes.content:
- Reorganized the Act 1 missions for a more gradual introduction to game mechanics.
- Possibly fixed a common editor crash.
- Made some balance changes to Act 4 missions on Ultra difficulty.
- Use the player's zig zag colors for health and power meters.

notes.title: Update 1.3.2i
notes.content:
1.3.2i
- Fixed a bug where zig zag hold notes could be cancelled by pressing the other direction too soon.
- Removed the number of rhythm inputs selection screen from the new game process.
- Missing hold notes no longer slows you in races.
- Full-screen can be toggled at the title screen using F11, added an instruction that shows on the first run.
- The default narration speed is faster.
- Add a faster narration option.
- The key to turn on narration at the title screen is now F1 instead of space.
- Fixed a bug causing auto-generated tracks to appear incorrect at the start.
- Fixed a bug where resetting mission progress was not resetting rig class.

notes.title: Update 1.3.2b
notes.content:
- DLC tracks and missions now have a DLC icon instead of a lock.
Editor:
- Track editor: Implemented undo/redo in simplified mode.
- Track editor: Implemented copy and paste in simplified mode.
- Show the selected range in all editors.
- Fixed a bug where the camera was wrong after restarting with F5.

notes.title: Update 1.3.2
notes.content:
This update begins to change the editors for greater accessibility.  All of the editors (song/track/world) now use the same basic navigation keys as the track editor did: arrows, page keys, and number keys to change the cursor resolution.

Track editor:
- Added a new advanced mode checkbox to the track menu.  Advanced mode is the existing mode where you can edit each spline point.
- The new non-advanced editing mode allows you to insert snippets by selecting them from where the cursor is.  This mode is still very early in development.

Song editor:
- Improved cursor.
- Fixed a bug where alt up/down to move between slices or notes sometimes did not work.
- Added a Zig Zag Size setting in the notes menu.
- Fix visual bugs with note hit flashes.
- Draw a "capsule" to represent jump notes when the model can't be generated.
- Fixed a bug where autoplay didn't automatically turn on the first time you edit a track.

All editors:
- The shortcut key for toggling the game camera is now ctrl-space.  This is in the view menu.
- All editors use the same basic navigation keys.  Using navigation keys puts the camera into the song edit view.
- All editors now use the same basic mouse navigation and camera controls.

Misc:
- Possibly fixed an issue where the game's audio stops playing and the game stops working properly from then on.

notes.title: Update 1.3.1h
notes.content:
1.3.1h
- Added an announcer volume setting.
- Fixed a bug where "power max" could be narrated repeatedly.

Olokun Dive! Campaign Testing Changes (for supporters)
- Using the J and K keys or right stick to navigate will skip already played missions.
- The grid location of missions is narrated.
- Fixed a couple of crashes.
- The mission grid saves its state between sessions.
- The player's health is saved between sessions.
- The mission grid resets on death.
- Added some new mission modifiers: Misses cost credits, speed boost disabled, hyper drift disabled.
- Added a new mission type: Pace car race.
- The quality filter missions now judge each section of the track separately.
- Missions can now have a randomized track.

notes.title: Update 1.3.1f
notes.content:
Update 1.3.1f
- Started adding support for the new expansion testing.  The expansion alpha build zip will be released later today.
	Check here for more info: https://igg.me/at/sequence-storm-olokun-dive

- Fixed a bug where narration would stop when scrolling a lot in the song editor.
- Fixed a bug where the scroll speed was not being saved properly.
- Fixed a bug where the pause menu could have items repeated.

notes.title: Update 1.3.1e
notes.content:
- The pause menu is now usable with the mouse.
- Fixed many bugs to do with using the mouse on the rig upgrades menu.
- Added a close button to the game settings menu.
- You can now get past the mission loading screen by clicking anywhere on the screen.
- Fixed the large ad banner on the title screen not working when narration is on.

notes.title: Update 1.3.1
notes.content:
- Added a new screen to the new game process which asks the player how many rhythm inputs they want to use.
- In the new game process, no longer ask the player which game mode they want to use when not using narration.

- Fixed a bug where the announcer could be too loud if you have turned down the music volume.

notes.title: SEQUENCE STORM is soon going to be free-to-play here on Steam!
notes.content:
SEQUENCE STORM is soon going to be free-to-play here on Steam!

This change should help to bring in more players, and help to grow the SEQUENCE STORM community.

What does this mean for existing players?  Rest assured that you will not lose any content.  You already own the two DLC packs that contain acts 3 and 4 of the story.  Free-to-play users will need to purchase these two DLCs separately.

What content and features will free players get?
- Acts 1 and 2 of the story campaign.
- 28 tracks in the Arcade, 6 of which are unlocked in the campaign.
- 10 Trial Sequence ranking courses in the Arcade.
- Arcade leaderboards.
- Access to the track editor and the Steam workshop.

This change is expected to happen on January 14th at the soonest.

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
Update 1.3.0

This update contains gameplay changes, performance updates, and editor improvements.

ALERT: If you are using the testing branch, please switch back to the main branch because the testing branch will no longer be updated.

Gameplay Changes
- Trial Sequences in the arcade can be played even if you don't own all of the tracks.
- Changed the Cornering stat point to Grip.  The player's rig will now visibly and audibly slide when losing grip.
- Made acceleration stat points much more effective.
- Improved rubber-banding for rivals.
- Boost power is now gained every four beats instead of every eight.
- The amount of healing from notes is now fixed per difficulty instead of based on note density of the track.
- Hard and Extreme difficulty can be unlocked by completing Trial Sequences 1 and 2 in the arcade.
- Some missions have been given new tracks:
	Act 3
		Hard Bargain - Chocolate
		Virtual Insanity - Connecting...
		Snake Fragment - Young Jaguar Theme
		Dove Fragment - Push/Pull
		The Vanished - Devious Rhinoceros
		Virtual Pets - BEAST MODE
	Act 4
		The Accidental Traitor - Wretched Hyena
		Hardcore Modding - Long-Legged Lie
		Weapons Training - Syndicate
		Ocean Hub - Chaos
		Mountain Hub - Wax And Wane

Interface
- Improved tracks and environments for Act 1 tracks.
- Rig colors can be customized in the loadout.
- New leaderboard UI shows everybody's rig choice and customisations.
- There is now one loadout per player in split-screen mode.
- Fixed an issue with split screen score mode that made the game look weird.
- Improved performance.
- Added an automatic draw distance option which automatically adjusts the draw distance to achieve at least 60 frames per second.
- Fix object pop-in.
- Added an FPS counter, toggleable with F11.

Editor Changes
- Updated the editor readme.txt file, and added a link to it from the editor menu in the Arcade (f2).
- On-track set pieces are now placed on sides of the track when the track sides are edited (streetlamps etc).
- Added a millisecond adjustment for sample offset.  Use the options Adjust Sample Millisecond Offset Earlier/Later in the instruments menu in the song editor (F4).
- Added a reset track command to the edit track menu in the track spline editor.

New Autogeneration Options
- Zig Zag autogeneration - This automatically shapes and links zig zags together.  This is turned on automatically for tracks that were created in an audible game mode.  The option can be found in the Notes menu in the song editor (F4).
- Track object autogeneration.  This automatically adds a default model to the track.  This can be found in the track objects menu in the world editor (F7).  This is automatically turned on for tracks with no authored environment.
- Track spline autogen.  This automatically generates a track spline.  This can be found in the track edit menu in the track editor (F6).  This is turned on automatically for tracks with no spline edits.
- New tracks, or any tracks that were using the blank default environment, get a random environment and skybox.

Known Issues
- There is no narration for player two's loadout.
- There is still a bug where some players may sometimes drive through barriers and pickups.

notes.title: Update 1.2.4e
notes.content:
Update 1.2.4e

Sequences updates:

Other updates:

notes.title: Update 1.2.4d

- Potentially fixed an issue that was causing crash logs to not be useful.  Please keep sending crash logs!

notes.title: Update 1.2.4
notes.content:
Update 1.2.4
- New DLC!  The Synchronized Attack Track Pack - Side B is out now!
    This pack contains six new tracks!
    https://store.steampowered.com/app/1460190/SEQUENCE_STORM__Synchronized_Attack_Track_Pack__Side_B/

Fixes:

notes.title: Update 1.2.3e
notes.content:
There is now a Discord server for SEQUENCE STORM: https://discord.gg/2bQWEWA

Update 1.2.3e
- In stealth missions, touching walls or missing notes no longer reduces your stealth.
- In "Project Avian" reduced the number of bots.
- Fixed a bug where a new track had no default BPM set.
- Fixed crashes and freezes that could happen when there is no BPM set.
- Fixed a bug where deleting all notes would cause the notes to reappear.
- For text entry fields, narrate the character being removed when using backspace or delete.
- For text entry fields, narrate the character being moved over when using left and right to move the cursor.
- Fix a bug with narrating the cursor position before beat zero.
- Fixed a bug where resetting mission progress did not reset your unlocked items.
- Added a link to the discord from the title screen.
- Fixed a bug with audible cues 1 mode where exiting the editor didn't return the audio cues properly back to AC1 mode.

notes.title: Update 1.2.3d
notes.content:
Update 1.2.3d
- Fixed a bug in the mission Mia Green Is Missing where the bot would shoot off too fast.
- Adjusted the volume levels of moving barriers, collision warning beep, and bots.
- Fixed a bug where rival car sounds didn't stop when the rival died.
- Added some Steam leaderboard supporter badges.

Editor changes
- Fixed a bug where saving caused the note graphics to disappear.

- Track editor - Fixed crashes that happened if you deleted all control points.

1.2.2
- This update will reset all audio cue sound selections to fix bugs that some people are having.

Song Editor

- Fixed a bug that caused the rig to float up and down after scrolling backwards.
- Pasting now selects the pasted notes.
- Add a reverse zig zags command to the notes menu.

- Fixed a bug where zig zags were drawing under jump notes.

notes.title: 1.2.1d
notes.content:
1.2.1d

Song Editor updates:
- Draw the sample waveform while the track plays.
- Moved all slice related options to a new Slices menu.

- Fix a bug where sometimes column notes do not draw.

notes.title: Version 1.1.13a
notes.content:
- Changed the appearance of wide note holds to be more promiment, and they also now curve with cylindrical tracks.

notes.title: Version 1.1.13 - Rig skins!
notes.content:
Version 1.1.13
- Fixed a crash in the demo.
- Added unlockable rig skins that can be earned by completing various missions.  There is a new skin available in the expansion preview available on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/specialmagicgames
- World editor: Added color bookmarks to the set piece color menu.
- Song editor: Added the ability to change the height of notes.
	For column notes, there is an option in the notes menu to set the height of selected notes.
	For zig zags, there are two ZZ height parameters that can be set in the track menu.
	The value for these range from 0 to 1, where 0 is normal and 1 corresponds to the height of a vertically flipped or mirrored track piece.

Version 1.2 feature progress:
- Rivals now steer into lanes.
- Rivals now use authored wall positions.
- Fixed many bugs with lanes.
- Added scoring for lanes.
- Audio cues for lanes are now different sounds for left and right turns.

- Lanes now persist when boosting.

notes.title: Version 1.1.12
notes.content:
1.1.12

Bug Fixes

- Fixed some bugs with rivals in tracks that have pauses or speed changes.
- Fixed tracks that have BPM changes in the audible cues modes.
- Fixed the audible mode turn cues in tracks that have pauses or speed changes.
- Fixed a potential crash when restarting a track.
- Fixed audio cues for very short holds in Audible Cues 2 mode.

Editor Changes

- A track can be switched to game version 2 in the "Track Info" menu, using the "toggle game version" option.

- A number of new editing features are availalbe in the "Edit" menu, including:
	Moving the track's left and right walls.
	Moving the track's center line.
	Adjusting the camera's height, pitch, roll.
	Adjusting the track's curvature.

- Added an early version of the "steering lanes" feature, but this does not currently work.
	These can be inserted in the song editor with the G key.  Shift-G can be used to set the end point of the lane.

- Set pieces can be recolored or retextured via the color and material menus.
- Improved performance of editing the track spline for tracks with a lot of set pieces on the track.
- Added a "Repeat Count To Cursor" option in the Track Objects menu in the world editor.
- Add menu items to enable note clap or metronome clap in the Play menu.

- Added support for custom set piece models on a track.
	The models must be obj format, and must have triangulated faces.
	The models can be textured with png files named:
		ModelName-diffuse.png
		ModelName-normal.png (normal maps do not look correct)
		ModelName-specular.png
		ModelName-emissive.png
		ModelName-reflective.png
	There must be a file called setpieces.json that defines how the set-pieces are used.
	There is an example at the end of these patch notes.


Known Issues

- Rivals still animate improperly during authored pauses.
- The graphics for "version 2" tracks are still incomplete.
- The interface for adjusting the new track and set piece parameters are not final.
- The new "steering lanes" game mechanic does not work.


setpieces.json example:

{
  "SetPieces": [
    {
      "Name": "Grassy Track",
      "StretchOverTrack": true,
      "Scale": 2.666,
      "Models": [
        {
          "Filename": "SetPieces/grassyTrack.obj",
          "DefaultReflectiveStrength": 0.0,
          "DefaultSpecularStrength": 0.0,
          "TextureFiltering": "Nearest"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "Name": "Olokun Cloud 1",
      "WriteToDepthBuffer": false,
      "Models": [
        {
          "Filename": "Olokun/cloud1.obj",
          "Billboard": true,
          "Shader": "FullBright",
          "DefaultReflectiveStrength": 0.0
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

notes.title: 1.0.6 - Leaderboards (beta)
notes.content:
Version 1.0.6 Notes

Steam Leaderboards have been added in a beta state.  This will be developed further after there are some scores in the system, and I get any feedback.

- Your scores and times in free-play will be uploaded to the leaderboards.

- Only new scores will be uploaded.  It is not possible for the leaderboards to be retroactive.

- In free play, view leaderboards with F3 or the X button.

- Due to limits on the number of possible leaderboards, scores for all timing difficulties go into the same leaderboard.  There is a 5% penalty for using moderate timing difficulty, and a 10% penalty for using loose timing.  By default, you will only see scores of players using the same difficulty as you, but you can toggle this filter with Space or the Y button in order to see the entire leaderboard.

Here's a bit more explanation about timing difficulties.  "Strict" is the intended difficulty, but it was found that many casual players struggled with this timing, so "Loose" was added to accommodate those players.  Then, the difference between Strict and Loose was too great, so Moderate was added in-between as a default.  It is intended that you must be using Strict timing in order to appear at the top of the leaderboard, but the filtering ability lets you see your place relative to other players using the same setting.

- Widened the hold release window at all timing difficulties.
- Removed the "rig class" selection from free play.  Many stats that depended on rig class now depend on selected difficulty.
- Best times and best rival beaten is no longer stored per rig class, which simplifies things for when leaderboards are added.
- Increased the scroll speed at lower difficulties in score mode.
- Fixed position of on-note particles for zig zag notes.
- Reworded the description of mission requirement for not touching the sides of the track.
- Changed how song previews fade out.
- Fixed an editor crash.
- Fixed some minor editor display bugs.

In FUTURE changes, expect to see STEAM LEADERBOARDS!  And more music!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 is coming this weekend!
notes.content:
ATTENTION DAEMONS!  Patch 1.0.5 is coming this weekend!  Here are some of the changes you can expect:

- Adds 5 new tracks.
- Most tracks are now unlocked by default.  The only tracks that are locked are the "boss" tracks at the end of each act.
- In free play, Medium difficulty is now unlocked by default.  Hard and Extreme difficulties are unlocked by completing acts 1 and 2.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4c
notes.content:
1.0.4c

Fixed a crash that happened when trying to bind a modifier key.

Fixed a bug where audio buffer length was not being calculated properly on some hardware.

Updated the copyright notice date.

notes.title: 1.0.4a and 1.0.4b
notes.content:
1.0.4a fixes a possible freeze that could happen when restarting the track.

1.0.4b allows you to select any mission in Standard difficulty that you have alredy completed in Challenge difficulty.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Notes
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.4

Added the Track Editor
- This is an early version of the track editor.  At the FREE PLAY song select, press F2 for an option to open the Tracks folder.  The Tracks folder contains a readme.txt with more information.

Achievements
- The achievements for completing the four acts will be awarded retroactively when starting the game.
- Added a new achievement for reaching a top speed of 275%.

High Scores and Times
- A separate set of high scores and times are saved for each timing difficulty.
- The game now saves the highest rival difficulty that you have beat in a race for each track.

Missions
- "MAN VS. MACHINE" is now slightly easier in Standard difficulty.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3e
notes.content:
Hello DAEMONS, this is another smallish update.

1.0.3e
- Added some Steam achievements - These are not retroactive, unfortunately
- Corrected spelling on the photosensitivity warning screen
- Can no longer use SPEED BOOST or steer beyond the end of the track
- Fixed an issue where log files could become very large due to OpenGL errors
- Lowered both health and miss damage in Extreme difficulty so that overall healing from notes is increased
- Raised the orange and blue lines off of the track a bit so that overlapping notes are more visible
- The hold release window is a bit smaller when using strict and medium timing difficulty
- Fixed a bug where you could press B to go back from the song loading screen before loading is done
- Fixed the display of the stat point purchase UI when you have all 10 points
- Created a new note chart for Antimony's Theme Extreme
- Slightly reduced the difficulty of Stuck Neck Cut Easy

notes.title: Version 1.0.3c
notes.content:
Version 1.0.3c

This small update fixes some minor issues.

- Greatly increased the difficulty of the hardest AI in free-play mode
- Reduced the volume of the Powerful Boosts sound effect
- Removed some broken UI graphics from split screen
- Added social media handle to the title screen
- Nerfed the Hyper Drift Extend item
- Improved some Extreme difficulty note patterns

Please let me know what you think or if you have any trouble.

I would love to be able to add more content to the game.  You can help by sharing your experience on social media, or by writing a review for the game.
